failure_modes.name: Insufficient_Retrieved_Evidence
failure_modes.evidence: (i) Summary_1 names the missing entity: 'A passage or source identifying the author of "The Polish Officer" (1995)' and Summary_2 reiterates: 'Any mention of "The Polish Officer" (1995)" - The specific novel cited in the claim is entirely absent from the passages'. (ii) Hop 2 and 3 queries both target this entity: 'Who is the author of "The Polish Officer" (1995)?'.
